name: The Historic Centre of Odesa
description: The historic heart of Odesa, a Black Sea port in southern Ukraine, is a grid of broad, tree-lined streets laid out in the 19th century. Low buildings of two to four storeys line them, among them theatres, palaces, banks, hotels and exchanges, many designed by Italian architects in the city's early years. Its mix of styles reflects a multi-ethnic port town. It was inscribed in 2023 and is listed as in danger because of the war.
